sections.title: Overview
sections.text:
| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| [GET](#get-cluster-ldap) | `/v1/cluster/ldap` | Get LDAP configuration |
| [PUT](#put-cluster-ldap) | `/v1/cluster/ldap` | Set/update LDAP configuration |
| [DELETE](#delete-cluster-ldap) | `/v1/cluster/ldap` | Delete LDAP configuration |

sections.title: Get LDAP configuration
sections.text:
GET /v1/cluster/ldap

Get the LDAP configuration.

#### Required permissions

| Permission name |
|-----------------|
| [view_ldap_config](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/permissions#view_ldap_config) |

sections.title: Request
sections.text:
#### Example HTTP request

	GET /v1/cluster/ldap 

#### Request headers

| Key | Value | Description |
|-----|-------|-------------|
| Host | cnm.cluster.fqdn | Domain name |
| Accept | application/json | Accepted media type |

sections.title: Response
sections.text:
Returns an [LDAP object](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/ldap).

#### Example JSON body

[code example]

sections.title: Update LDAP configuration
sections.text:
PUT /v1/cluster/ldap

Set or update the cluster LDAP configuration.

#### Required permissions

| Permission name |
|-----------------|
| [config_ldap](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/permissions#config_ldap) |

sections.title: Request
sections.text:
#### Example HTTP request

	POST /v1/cluster/ldap 

#### Example JSON body

[code example]

#### Request headers

| Key | Value | Description |
|-----|-------|-------------|
| Host | cnm.cluster.fqdn | Domain name |
| Accept | application/json | Accepted media type |


#### Request body

Include an [LDAP object](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/ldap) with updated fields in the request body.

sections.title: Response
sections.text: Returns a status code. If an error occurs, the response body may include an error code and message with more details.

sections.title: Error codes
sections.text:
Possible `error_code` values:

| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| illegal_fields_combination | An unacceptable combination of fields was specified for the configuration object (e.g.: two mutually-exclusive fields), or a required field is missing.|

sections.title: Status codes
sections.text:
| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| [200 OK](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.2.1) | Success, LDAP config has been set. |
| [400 Bad Request](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.4.1) | Bad or missing configuration parameters. |
